scope: actual FIT64-trained encoder critic and reused64-image development calibration; no freshDEV/TEST inference or GT scoring

protocol.scope: FIT64 training / reused CAL64 model selection; fresh DEV64 and TEST512 not inferred or scored
protocol.features: Fixed risk.py whitelist: source/identity/candidate detector statistics and source matching incl weak detections, class counts, paid ratio, profile/codec/QP, current/feature/pseudoAP costs. No GT, IDs, split/hash, or pseudo-loss inputs.
protocol.training: All168 profile/codec/QP rows per FIT image, 64images only; same row count per image; no row-random CV or CAL fitting. Separate marginal cohort labels. Exactly two prespecified forest fits.
protocol.calibration_selection: For each model minimize mean log actual per-image paid ratio plus equally weighted scaled AP drop over8 codec/QP conditions; scales from CAL anchor endpoint secants, invalid spans abort. Select best negative-utility model, fixed model order then smaller threshold ties, else identity. Utility is NOT BD-rate.
protocol.deployment_selection: Identity always available; accept candidates with predicted scaled marginal AP damage<=threshold and actual paid bytes<=same-condition identity; choose minimum paid bytes then smaller profile ID. No GT.

fresh_dev_gate.scope: one fresh64-image DEV evaluation after exact model/policy hash lock, no refit or retuning on it
fresh_dev_gate.per_codec_objective: mean log actual paid ratio + frozen CAL endpoint scale * mean four-QP AP drop
fresh_dev_gate.decision: both utilities strictly below log(.85) and complete provenance/block checks -> one frozen reserved512 TEST evaluation; otherwise no TEST. Identity cannot pass. Utility is a go/no-go resource rule, not a BD claim.
fresh_dev_gate.revision: Any change after inspecting freshDEV consumes it as development and requires another untouched confirmation cohort. TEST never used for selection.

protocol.final_success: Both actual TEST raw four-point PCHIP BD-rates strictly below -15%, common quality support, no extrapolation or point repair; undefined never passes. Point estimates and confidence limitations separately reported.
